name: Hometown
source:
Not everything went as planned in college. You had your ups and downs, a few heartbreaks too but you managed through and it paid off. You landed yourself a job in renowned architect company and on top of it it's located back in your beloved hometown! You are settling yourself in your new apartment as you meet your talkative neighbour Benny. You must admit, he is quite sweet. On your first day at work you get to know your new boss. What... What is his name? He didn't tell you. For some reason he seems a bit too clingy to you...

[From [url=https://neoninnes.itch.io/hometown]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学里并不是一切都按计划进行。你经历过起起落落，也经历过一些心碎，但你克服了一切，并得到了回报。你在著名的建筑师公司找到了一份工作，而且它位于你深爱的家乡！当你在新公寓安顿下来时，你遇到了健谈的邻居本尼。你必须承认，他很可爱。在上班的第一天，你就会认识你的新老板。什么……他叫什么名字？他没有告诉你。不知为什么，他似乎对你有点太粘人了……

[来自[url=https://neoninnes.itch.io/hometown]Itch.io[/url]]
